SHOW3D: Capturing Scenes of 3D Hands and Objects in the Wild
	

Patrick Rim, Kevin Harris, Braden Copple, Shangchen Han, Xu Xie, Ivan Shugurov, Sizhe An, He Wen,
Alex Wong, Tomas Hodan, and Kun He
CVPR 2026; https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.28760

SHOW3D is a large-scale multi-view dataset of hand–object interactions captured in the wild.
It is intended to advance research on egocentric 3D hand–object interaction understanding,
and generalization of perception models to real-world… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/show3d-dataset.
